subject: Game Theory
title: Federalism as a Game
description: One-minute skill: Federalism as a Game.

hook.text: Should states set their own tax rates? In the US, states compete to attract businesses with lower taxes.

buildup.text: Fiscal competition between states is a prisoner's dilemma: all cut taxes, all lose revenue, nobody wins.

discovery.text: This 'race to the bottom' in taxes and regulations drives down public services that businesses also need.

twist.text: But federalism also enables experimentation. States can try policies others copy if they work.

climax.text: The balance between competition and coordination defines effective federal design.

punchline.text: Competing states can race to the bottom.

quiz.question: What happens when states compete to lower taxes?
options: A race to the bottom in public services
